propositions: auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container mid-flight, the interrupted review casts fail-closed LLM-Review -1, and that blocking vote prevents the existing backfill reconciler recovery from re-driving the change
drain timeout is 45s but review timeout is 1200s, causing deploys to kill in-flight reviews instead of waiting for completion
retryable coverage-gap failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should cast NO vote and defer to the reconciler instead of fail-closed -1 so backfill can retry
bounded escalation: after N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision, cast fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and emit VOTER_ERROR metric
change 1 raises DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and updates stop_grace_period to 1320s so the drain waits for in-flight reviews to complete
change 2 threads gap_reason through adapter decisions and implements vote-less deferral for retryable conditions with a new review_attempts ledger keyed (change_id, revision)
